youtube.title: Turn Your Old Android Into a PC Control Panel | PhoneBox
youtube.description:
Turn an old Android phone into a customizable computer control panel with PhoneBox, an open-source desk dashboard. See system stats, control media and volume, and access shortcuts from your phone.

PhoneBox uses an Android app and a desktop agent. Connect over USB or paired Wi-Fi, then choose and arrange widgets in the browser editor. Features and setup vary by operating system and hardware; check the setup guide before installing.

PhoneBox: https://github.com/ersinkoc/phonebox
Setup: https://github.com/ersinkoc/phonebox/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md

Project screenshots show demo data. Animated illustrations and cover are conceptual. AI narration. PhoneBox by Ersin Koç and contributors; MIT License: https://github.com/ersinkoc/phonebox/blob/main/LICENSE
